config.mode: live (no network retries, no cache); one warm-up call per decider first

construction.state: seed 1001, blue alliance at match time 35.00 s (scripted basic_cycle play up to then); shared state text = renderSharedStateText of B1-B3's views
construction.size3: next_action_B1..B3 (each with that robot's masked options and its own self-description in the instructions)
construction.size8: the 3 action questions + 3 captain-role questions (B1..B3, none assigned yet) + 2 follow-up questions
construction.size32: the 3 action questions + 3 captain-role questions + 26 follow-up questions ("robot X will do <option> first; choose the follow-up", options = masked ALLOWED_PAIRS follow-ups), round-robin over B1..B3

prices._note: US dollars per 1M tokens. byModel (exact model id) takes precedence over byId (provider fallback). null = unknown: cost is then recorded as 0, never guessed. Sources, 2026-11-14: DeepInfra models are from the pricing metadata in its live model list, and DeepInfra responses also report usage.estimated_cost, which is recorded in preference. Drex is VERIFIED from the Nace console usage export (2026-11-14, confirmed by the project owner): 0.03 per 1M input tokens and output tokens free, the same for drex-v2.0 and drex-latest (drex-max-v1.1). NDI is not token-priced: each job reports its own charge, which is what the ledger records. openai and gemini are not filled in.

environment.network: home Wi-Fi, shared with other agents
